Definition: a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment)
BiblicalUsage: 1) robe; 1a) a garment worn over a tunic by men of rank; 1b) a long garment worn by David's daughters; 1c) a garment of the high priest; 1d) (fig.) of attributes
